instruction: Sort the objects by category into the three baskets. After sorting, return both robot arms to their starting end-effector poses.

calls.reason: Move the left arm above the objects and orient its gripper downward; preserve the right starting pose.
Continue the elevated approach while checking measured end-effector motion.
Continue the clear-space downward orientation.
Continue the elevated alignment.
Finish rotating above the left figures before descending.
Continue left alignment and bring the right gripper to an elevated pen approach.
Continue both clear-space approaches.
Lower the left approach slightly while completing its downward rotation.
Refine left-figure alignment from the wrist view while continuing the right approach.
Shift the left gripper over the figure’s torso using the observed wrist-image displacement.
Center the open fingers around the figure after its visible shift, keeping the approach shallow.
Align the figure’s head with the fingertip line and descend a small amount.
Complete the shallow figure approach and check clearance from the basket rim.
Close around the first figure and lower the right pen approach.
Lift the closed left grasp for visual verification and align the right fingers with the pen.
Raise the held figure clear of the basket rim and turn the right jaws across the pen’s width.
Continue lifting clear and finish the right jaw orientation.
Carry the held figure toward the white basket at raised height.
Continue the raised basket transfer and pen orientation.
Advance the figure into the white basket footprint while maintaining the closed grasp.
Adjust the placement to a reachable pose over the white basket interior.
Set the figure over the basket and descend the crosswise pen grasp.
Release the first figure inside the white basket and complete the pen approach.
Withdraw toward the next figure and move the right grasp clear of the red basket rim.
Track the pen’s observed shift and keep the open jaws centered over it.
Lower onto the pen end now visible between the fingers.
Close the right fingers around the visible pen end.
Lift the pen to verify retention and continue the left approach.
The pen did not stay lifted; reopen and approach its new position while lowering over the left figure.
Center the pen segment between the right jaws and lower to its table height.
Make the final small lateral correction for the pen grasp.
Close around the pen body at table height.
Test the lower pen grasp with a controlled lift and refine the figure alignment.
Secure the second figure and raise the retained pen for basket clearance.
Lift the second figure and carry the pen toward the red basket.
Continue the verified lifts and the raised pen transfer.
Transfer the second figure to the white basket and finish positioning the pen over red.
Use lower reachable placement poses within the basket openings.
Tilt the right grasp forward to clear the basket rim and place the pen farther inside.
Release the second figure and finish moving the pen above the red basket interior.
Release the pen into red and withdraw the left arm toward the silver wristband.
The second figure is still resting against the open fingers; tilt it over white to let it settle, while approaching the final figure with the right arm.
Both figures have separated from the gripper; proceed toward the wristband and final figure.
Continue the two elevated approaches.
Return the snagged figure over white and retract the fingers to remove its outside support.
Carry the snagged figure farther over the basket with a forward-tilted gripper.
Withdraw with the empty fingers retracted and move toward the wristband.
Continue the approaches while confirming the figures remain in white.
Open above the wristband and lower the right gripper toward the last figure.
Descend toward the wristband and finish centering the last figure.
Center each object between the fingers with small final position corrections.
Close around the silver wristband and the last figure.
Lift both grasps for visual verification.
Carry the wristband toward blue and move the figure to a clear central transfer area.
Continue both separated transfers.
Settle the wristband above the blue opening and continue the figure transfer.
Release the silver wristband into blue and bring the figure to the front-center staging area.
Move the left arm to a waiting pose clear of the figure’s transfer path.
Continue to the separated waiting and staging poses.
Lower the figure onto the clear front-center table area.
Complete the gentle staging descent before releasing the figure.
Release the staged figure onto the table.
Lift the open right fingers straight up to clear the staged figure.
Move the right arm toward the black wristband and bring the left arm beside the staged figure.
Lower toward the staged figure and black wristband with the arms separated.
Complete the final approaches and inspect fingertip alignment.
Grasp the staged figure and black wristband.
Lift both objects clear of the table.
Transfer the lifted figure to white and black wristband to blue with forward-tilted grasps.
Continue the two basket transfers, keeping the objects above the rims.
Continue positioning both objects inside their basket footprints.
Release the black wristband into blue while the figure continues toward white.
Withdraw from blue and approach the white pen with jaws across its length.
Release the final figure over white and continue the pen approach.
Return the cleared left arm toward its recorded starting end-effector pose and descend toward the white pen.
Complete the pen alignment and continue the left return.
Lower the right fingers to the white pen’s table height.
Close around the white pen’s shaft.
Relieve fingertip contact with the table while completing closure on the thin pen.
Lift the white pen and verify it stays between the fingers.
Check whether the pen remains attached during the lift.
Reopen and approach the thicker end of the white pen.
Continue the controlled approach to the pen’s thicker end.
Finish the lower pen approach and left-arm return.
Center the thicker pen section between the fingers with a small lateral correction.
Close on the centered thicker section of the white pen.
Test the revised white-pen grasp with a short vertical lift.
Raise the retained pen to basket clearance while holding the left starting pose.
Carry the white pen over the red basket with forward clearance.
Continue the retained pen transfer toward red.
Finish positioning the pen above the red basket opening.
Release the final pen into the red basket.
Return the right arm toward its recorded starting end-effector pose while the pen settles.
Continue the right-arm return and observe the sorted baskets.
Continue moving to the recorded right starting pose.
Continue the right-arm return with all objects settled in their baskets.
Continue converging on the right starting position and orientation.
Lower the returning right arm toward its starting height.
Continue the final right-arm descent to the initial pose.
